provider_settings.note: Settings -> Data providers (docs/PROVIDER_SETTINGS.md). Field names are Settings (main) or NotificationSettings (notifications) attributes; values are written to the project .env, secrets are never returned.
provider_settings.destination_note: Destination field -> the secret sent to it. A PUT that changes a destination while a secret is stored must carry that secret too (re-entered, or null to remove it): a stored key is never sent to a new address.

groups.label: Ollama
groups.description: AI analysis roles (when selected) and the web search used to corroborate unverified claims.
groups.pricing: Free tier with usage limits; paid plans raise them

fields.name: ollama_api_key
fields.label: API key
fields.help: Create a key on ollama.com (Settings -> Keys). Used for chat and web search.

fields.name: ollama_base_url
fields.label: API base URL
fields.help: Keep the default for Ollama Cloud; a local Ollama uses http://localhost:11434/api.

test.label: Test connection
test.note: Lists the model catalog and runs one web search (uses a little of your Ollama quota).

groups.label: OpenAI
groups.description: Optional AI vendor for the analysis roles, used only when the AI provider is set to OpenAI.

fields.name: openai_api_key
fields.label: API key
fields.help: Secret key from the OpenAI platform (API keys page).

fields.name: openai_base_url
fields.label: API base URL
fields.help: Change only for an OpenAI-compatible gateway.

groups.label: AI provider
groups.description: Which vendor runs the AI analysis roles. Web search always uses Ollama.

fields.name: llm_provider
fields.label: AI provider
fields.help: After switching, run model discovery and assign the roles again in Settings -> AI models.

groups.label: Massive (formerly Polygon.io)
groups.description: US stock, index and FX snapshots.
groups.pricing: Free plan (end-of-day data, few calls per minute); snapshots and real time need a paid plan

fields.name: massive_api_key
fields.label: API key
fields.help: Key from the Massive dashboard (Keys page).

test.label: Test connection
test.note: One snapshot request (counts toward your plan's call limit).

groups.label: Finnhub
groups.description: Real-time quotes for the tracked US equities and ETF proxies.

fields.name: finnhub_api_key
fields.label: API key
fields.help: Key from the Finnhub dashboard.

test.label: Test connection
test.note: One quote request (counts toward the 60 calls per minute limit).

groups.label: Alpaca Market Data (IEX)
groups.description: US stock and ETF snapshots (real-time from the IEX exchange only, not the consolidated tape): ETF proxies (SPY, QQQ, IWM, GLD, UUP, USO, BNO), the equity fallback when Finnhub is unavailable, daily bars for technical levels and Benzinga news. Market data only: the app never calls Alpaca trading endpoints.
groups.pricing: Free (paper account, IEX real-time, personal use)

fields.name: alpaca_api_key_id
fields.label: API key ID
fields.help: Generate the key pair on a PAPER account (the ID usually starts with PK). Alpaca keys can also place orders; this app only reads data.alpaca.markets.

fields.name: alpaca_api_secret_key
fields.label: API secret key
fields.help: Shown once when the key pair is generated.

test.label: Test connection
test.note: One IEX snapshot request for SPY (counts toward the 200 calls per minute of the free plan).

groups.label: FRED (St. Louis Fed)
groups.description: Macro series and the BAA10Y credit-spread feature.

fields.name: fred_api_key
fields.label: API key
fields.help: Free key from your FRED account (API Keys page).

groups.label: BLS (US Bureau of Labor Statistics)
groups.description: CPI, payrolls, unemployment and PPI series. Works without a key.
groups.pricing: Free; an optional key raises the daily query limit

fields.name: bls_api_key
fields.label: API key (optional)
fields.help: Without a key BLS allows about 25 queries per day.

test.label: Test connection
test.note: Uses 1 of your daily BLS queries (about 25 per day without a key).

groups.label: Financial Modeling Prep
groups.description: Economic and earnings calendar with consensus and actual values.
groups.pricing: Free plan: 250 calls per day; some calendars need a paid plan

fields.name: fmp_api_key
fields.label: API key
fields.help: Key from your FMP dashboard.

test.label: Test connection
test.note: One calendar request (counts toward your daily call limit).

groups.label: Congress.gov
groups.description: Bills and legislative activity from the Library of Congress API.

fields.name: congress_api_key
fields.label: API key
fields.help: Free key (api.data.gov) sent by e-mail after sign-up.

groups.label: SEC EDGAR
groups.description: Company filings and EDGAR full-text search. No key: SEC requires a contact e-mail in the User-Agent. The same contact identifies the BLS release-schedule calendar (BLS blocks anonymous robots).

fields.name: sec_user_agent
fields.label: User-Agent (name and e-mail)
fields.help: Your name or company and a real contact e-mail; example.com addresses are rejected.

groups.label: X (Twitter) API
groups.description: Recent posts from monitored accounts and keywords (discovery only).
groups.pricing: Pay per use (prepaid credits); there is no free tier

fields.name: x_bearer_token
fields.label: Bearer token
fields.help: App bearer token from the X developer console.

test.label: Test connection
test.note: One recent search (billed by X as pay-per-use).

fields.name: reuters_base_url
fields.label: Gateway URL
fields.help: Base URL of your licensed gateway (it serves GET /news).

fields.name: reuters_api_key
fields.label: Gateway key
fields.help: Bearer key for your gateway.

groups.label: AP (licensed gateway)
groups.description: Licensed Associated Press news through your own gateway that returns the documents contract.

fields.name: ap_base_url
fields.label: Gateway URL
fields.help: Base URL of your licensed gateway (it serves GET /news).

fields.name: ap_api_key
fields.label: Gateway key
fields.help: Bearer key for your gateway.

groups.label: Telegram
groups.description: High-priority alerts sent to a Telegram chat by your own bot.

fields.name: telegram_bot_token
fields.label: Bot token
fields.help: Create a bot with @BotFather and paste the token it gives you.

fields.name: telegram_chat_id
fields.label: Chat ID
fields.help: The chat, group or channel that receives the alerts (for example 123456789 or -100...).

test.label: Send test message
test.note: Sends one real message to the configured chat.

groups.label: E-mail (SMTP)
groups.description: High-priority alerts by e-mail through your own SMTP server or mail provider.
groups.pricing: Your own mail server or provider

fields.name: smtp_host
fields.label: SMTP server
fields.help: Host name of the SMTP server.

fields.name: smtp_port
fields.label: Port
fields.help: 587 with STARTTLS, 465 with SSL/TLS.

fields.name: smtp_username
fields.label: Username
fields.help: Leave empty if the server does not require a login.

fields.name: smtp_password
fields.label: Password
fields.help: For Gmail and similar providers use an app password.

fields.name: smtp_from
fields.label: From address
fields.help: Sender address of the alert e-mails.

fields.name: smtp_to
fields.label: Recipients
fields.help: One or more addresses, separated by commas.

fields.name: smtp_starttls
fields.label: Use STARTTLS
fields.help: Upgrade the connection with STARTTLS (usual on port 587). A login needs STARTTLS or SSL/TLS unless the server is this computer (localhost).

fields.name: smtp_ssl
fields.label: Use SSL/TLS
fields.help: Connect with implicit TLS (usual on port 465).

test.label: Send test message
test.note: Sends one real e-mail to every recipient.

groups.label: Browser push (Web Push)
groups.description: Medium and high-priority alerts as browser notifications. Needs the optional pywebpush package.

fields.name: webpush_vapid_public_key
fields.label: VAPID public key
fields.help: Public half of your VAPID key pair (base64url).

fields.name: webpush_vapid_private_key
fields.label: VAPID private key
fields.help: Private half of your VAPID key pair.

fields.name: webpush_subject
fields.label: Contact
fields.help: A mailto: or https: contact that push services can reach.

test.label: Send test message
test.note: Sends one notification to every subscribed browser.

groups.label: Provider mode
groups.description: live uses real providers only. stub replaces paid providers that have no key with labelled development data that never reaches decisions.

fields.name: provider_mode
fields.label: Provider mode
fields.help: Use live for real use; stub only for development without keys.
